title: Turkish-Style Radish Borek
description: A Japanese-inspired twist on traditional Turkish borek, with the addition of radish and rich flavor.
instructions: Roll out the pastry dough to a thickness of 1/8 inch.
Cut the dough into 4-6 equal pieces.
Place a sheet of dough on a flat surface and brush with butter.
Sprinkle a quarter of the radish slices onto the dough, leaving a 1/2 inch border.
Sprinkle a quarter of the mozzarella cheese onto the radish.
Sprinkle a pinch of Turkish spice blend onto the cheese.
Fold the dough in half over the filling and press the edges together to seal.
Repeat with the remaining dough and filling.
Place the borek on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper.
Brush the tops with butter and bake for 25-30 minutes, or until golden brown.
